content.title: Towards Robust Dataset Learning
content.TL;DR: We study the problem of learning a robust dataset such that any classifier naturally trained on the dataset is adversarially robust.
content.abstract: We study the problem of learning a robust dataset such that any classifier naturally trained on the dataset is adversarially robust. Such a dataset benefits the downstream tasks as natural training is much faster than adversarial training, and demonstrates that the desired property of robustness is transferable between models and data. In this work, we propose a principled, tri-level optimization to formulate the robust dataset learning problem. We show that, under an abstraction model that characterizes robust vs. non-robust features, the proposed method provably learns a robust dataset. Extensive experiments on MNIST, CIFAR10, and TinyImageNet demostrate the effectiveness of our algorithm with different network initializations and architectures.
